items.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023
items.q: My favorites are by people who are not critics like Dave Frishberg and Alan Bergman.

ctx.x: Sounds like a “Math Camp” review. Yeah that’s fine. Yeah that’s okay. You know I mean nobody likes getting slammed but you know for the most part I’ve had some very © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
interesting things said about me. My favorites are by people who are not critics like Dave Frishberg and Alan Bergman. But yeah, I can see that. Sure.
